latest_release.name: OpenIDEA v0.1.39
latest_release.body:
OpenIDEA 0.1.39 adds dev containers, an editable database result grid, Tomcat Server run configurations, a Project Structure dialog, JetBrains settings import and a rebuilt agent conversation view, and ships Plugin API 1.3.

### Download

**Remote development:** `openidea-server` for [Linux x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.39/openidea-server-linux-x86_64.gz) · [Linux ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.39/openidea-server-linux-aarch64.gz) · [macOS x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.39/openidea-server-macos-x86_64.gz) · [macOS ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.39/openidea-server-macos-aarch64.gz), each with a `.sha256` file.

**Already installed?** OpenIDEA updates itself: use **Check for Updates**.

## What's new

### Remote
- **Dev containers:** reopen a local project in its dev container and forward the container's ports.
- SSH reads `ProxyCommand`, `Include`, `Match` and `none` auth from `~/.ssh/config`.

### Plugins (Preview)
- **Plugin API 1.3** (`openidea:plugin@1.3.0`); plugins built for earlier 1.x versions keep loading.
- Editor: add semantic colours, hover text, inlay hints, gutter icons and live diagnostics in any language; indexed workspace symbols, usages and rename.
- Files and processes: write files, read outside the project, private persistent directories, batched file events, long-running processes and PTY sessions.
- UI: multi-page settings, plugin-backed content and log editor tabs, tool-window web views with their own header, detail panes, sortable tables, notification actions, submenus and grouped views.
- Plugins can ship translations, take part in the commit workflow, share HTTP endpoints, and create, rename and delete files from a code action.

### Agents
- A new conversation view with folded tool runs, inline `@file` and `/skill` tags, jump to latest, retract, and project drag-and-drop.
- Rename tasks, roll back to a fresh session, and choose the thinking level before a task starts.
- Question cards for Claude's AskUserQuestion, Codex and Qwen Code; background tasks shown above the composer; Mermaid diagrams in replies.
- Command approvals show the script inside a shell wrapper, and full-access settings are honoured for tool approvals.

detail.readme_excerpt:
The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust.

Download  ·  Benchmark  ·  Plugins  ·  Community

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA way of working — its keymap, its tool windows, its search-everything habits — to a native app with a Rust core. Editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients, for 60+ languages. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. On Windows, if you'd rather skip the installer, each release also ships a portable zip — unpack it and run `openidea.exe`. ## Benchmark Opening [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade) (Python, ~770 files) with warm caches, median of 5 runs: | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | | Window with the project | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | Ready (CPU settled) | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | Memory (USS, all processes) | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | CPU time until ready | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | Idle CPU | **4 %** of a core | 7 % of a core | | Quit | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | A release build of OpenIDEA from `main` and IDEA with default settings and plugins, on Windows 11, 32-core AMD, 62 GB RAM. IDEA analyses Python more deeply, so "ready" doesn't mean the same work on both sides. Both are measured from the outside, the same way: see [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) to run it on your machine and projects. ## Plugins Plugins add actions, completion, quick fixes, tool windows, custom editors, themes, file icons and languages. They run as sandboxed WebAssembly components; themes, icon themes and languages need no code at all. Install them from Settings › Plugins, or start your own with `openidea-plugin new` — see [Writing OpenIDEA plugins](plugins/README.md) and the [official plugins](plugins/official). The plugin API is still a preview. ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP) — questions, feedback and release news. - WeChat group — scan to join: ### Contributors ## License [Apac
